steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Kanboard with username 'admin' and password 'admin' (submit the login form). Then verify you are signed in and report what page you land on.

02-open: Navigate to the project named 'Bench Board' and open its board view. Report the names of the board's columns in their left-to-right order, exactly as displayed on the board (do not modify or move any tasks; this is read-only). Also report the titles of any task cards currently visible on the board.

03-create: In the Kanboard project 'Bench Board', create a new task with title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Task' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task created for run {{runid}}'). Fill any other required fields as needed, submit the form, and then report the task's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (Kanboard shows it as #<number> on the task page/card) and the task title shown. Do not modify the existing 'Seed:' tasks.

04-edit: In the Kanboard project 'Bench Board', move the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (task {{03-create.task_id_as_displayed}}) so that it sits in the '{{02-open.board_column_work_in_progress}}' column of the board. You can drag the card on the board or use the task page's move/edit action — whatever works. Then verify by opening the board and report which column the card '{{runid}} Bench Task' is now in. Do not move or modify the 'Seed:' tasks.

05-open: Open the task page for task {{03-create.task_id_as_displayed}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the Kanboard project 'Bench Board' and add a comment to that task whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment added for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment form. Then verify the comment appears on the task page and report the exact comment text shown and who/when it was posted if displayed.

06-set: On the task page for task {{03-create.task_id_as_displayed}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the Kanboard project 'Bench Board', set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (December 31, 2026). Use the task's edit form or the due-date action on the task page. Then verify the due date is displayed as 2026-12-31 on the task page and report the exact due date value shown.

07-change: Final verification (read-only, do not change anything): Open the task page for task {{03-create.task_id_as_displayed}} '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the Kanboard project 'Bench Board', and also open the project's board view. Report all of the following exactly as displayed: (a) the task's numeric ID as shown (e.g. {{03-create.task_id_as_displayed}}), (b) the task title, (c) the task's description text, (d) the column the task is in on the board, (e) the text of any comments on the task, (f) the task's due date as displayed, and (g) the board's column names left-to-right. Do not edit anything.
